correctness.rationale: Classify all 3-multisets of residues mod 4 up to simultaneous shift/permutation into five patterns. Three patterns force modulus dividing 3 or order less than 4. Remaining patterns imply q=-2 mod e or 2q=-1 mod e, whence q^4=1 gives e|15 via exact integer identities. Only e=5,15 support order 4; at e=5 q²=-1 and m=2, at e=15 q7,13 give three-term witnesses with no two-term -1, while q2,8 yield no three-term sum. Independent enumeration for every modulus 2<=e<=1000 and all order-four unit residues found exactly (15,7),(15,13). The universal exclusion uses identities, not bounded search.
residual_risks: Classification is only m=3 at order 4, not all m-values or larger orders.
